convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load 'Karacatica' custom indicator and depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh external library for all trade execution (open/close position logic, money management). Custom indicator buffers require understanding of the indicator's internal logic.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - seconds for one timeframe bar
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for trade execution timing

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required before processing

other_exits: Opposite Karacatica signal closes existing position: UpValue signal closes short, DnValue signal closes long. Additional historical bar scan (bars SignalBar+1 to end) checks for earlier opposite signals when both open and close flags are enabled but no close signal found on current bar.

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum determines sizing: LOT=fixed lot size (0.1), FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss. MM input (0.1) serves as either lot size or fraction depending on MMMode.

custom_logic_notes: EA uses a two-pass signal detection: first checks SignalBar (default=1, previous bar) for entry signals, then if both BuyPosOpen+BuyPosClose or SellPosOpen+SellPosClose are true but no close signal found on SignalBar, scans remaining history bars for earlier opposite signals to trigger position closes. Signal times are calculated as SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE + TimeShiftSec, used by TradeAlgorithms.mqh for trade timing. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose booleans independently gate each action. Recount flag triggers re-evaluation on CopyBuffer failures.
python_conversion_notes: Must reimplement or port the Karacatica custom indicator logic since it is loaded via iCustom. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library handles all position open/close with money management - this must be fully reimplemented in Python including the 5 MarginMode variants. The historical bar scan for opposite signals (lines 122-148) is an unusual pattern that must be replicated exactly. SL/TP are in points (not pips), so no digit adjustment is needed - they are passed directly to the trade functions. The SignalBar parameter controls which bar is used for signal detection (default bar[1]), critical for avoiding look-ahead bias in backtesting.
